judge_issues.message: The narrative states a program expense ratio of 83.5% for FY2024, but the Charity Navigator source data for FY2024 reports 81.21% (or 81.2%).
The narrative states fundraising costs of $0.11 per $1 raised, but Charity Navigator reports fundraising expense ratio as approximately 6.78% ($0.07 per $1 raised).
The narrative states working capital of 4.3 months, but Form 990 calculations and source data show a working capital ratio of 9.48 (or 4.3 months based on a different fiscal year/source definition).
The charity is classified as ibn_sabil, but their programs primarily serve fuqara (poor) and masakin (needy) through medical aid and hunger relief.

strengths_deep_dive: SAPA demonstrates strong financial directness by allocating <cite id="1">81.2% of overall expenditures to direct emergency health and relief operations</cite>. Its fundraising efficiency remains lean, spending only <cite id="1">$0.11 per $1 raised</cite>. Backed by a <cite id="1">90.0/100 from Charity Navigator rating</cite> and verified outcome tracking, SAPA delivers rapid medical intervention to underserved populations in active crisis regions [4].
rich_narrative.summary: Sudanese American Physicians Association (SAPA) provides direct medical aid and emergency relief to communities facing crisis in Sudan and Chad. Founded in 2019, the organization works directly with local health providers to build resilient medical infrastructure during active conflict [4]. In FY2024, SAPA reported <cite id="6">$7,254,154 in total revenue</cite>, reflecting early-stage growth from its $442,259 revenue in FY2022. The organization maintains a high <cite id="1">program expense ratio of 83.5%</cite>, which exceeds the 75% industry standard and beats the peer median of 83.3%. SAPA maintains a <cite id="1">90/100 overall rating from Charity Navigator</cite> and holds a <cite id="4">Platinum Seal of Transparency from Candid</cite>. The charity is verified as <cite id="5">Zakat-eligible</cite>, routing funds to eligible categories including the poor and needy in conflict zones [5]. With direct service delivery, SAPA maintains an efficient cost structure serving approximately <cite id="4">700,000 beneficiaries</cite>.
